verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a sales-tax compliance platform, so modeling marketplace-facilitator sales is a fair question for it. The evidence covers transaction sync, nexus lookback across a calendar-year window, and filing and remittance, but nothing says facilitator-collected sales (Amazon, app stores) are flagged, counted toward nexus thresholds, or excluded from remittance to avoid double-paying. Absent any such evidence, the verdict is none.
